verdict.rationale: Snyk Open Source documents actionable fix advice and pull-request-based fix workflows for vulnerable dependencies. The CLI reports the dependency path and fix guidance for each issue, and the Remediation Agent (`snyk fix --agentic`) can apply and verify fixes. Community users confirm the automated dependency-update PRs exist, though they criticise PR volume and version choices; that is a quality complaint, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the upgrade-path output and PR configuration (e.g. which ecosystems and SCMs are supported), and positive independent hands-on corroboration of fix-PR quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get concrete upgrade paths or automated fix pull requests that remediate vulnerable dependencies

citations.quote: Snyk provides actionable fix advice for vulnerabilities and supports workflows to fix vulnerabilities using pull requests.
